rows.en: Zentradi Main Fleet Supreme Commander. Fearing a myth that\nProtoculture contact saps the will to fight, he deems cultured\nhumans Protoculture, to be destroyed. (CV: Osamu Ichikawa)
rows.notes: review: refit: 'legend' -> 'myth'; restructured: 'he'd destroy cultured humanity as Protoculture' | review: restored that he judges humanity to be Protoculture and sets out to destroy it

rows.en: Zentradi Main Fleet Supreme Commander, and the central\nbio-unit of his flagship. He grasps a little of Culture, and will\nuse any means, however cruel, to win. (CV: Osamu Ichikawa)
rows.notes: review: "Boddole" alone is not a glossary form (Boddole Zer); the same source phrase is rendered as Boddole Zer's flagship in u0752, and since this profile is Boddole Zer himself, "his flagship" is accurate. | review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: Chosen as a new fighter's test pilot for his superb flying skill.\nHe grew up with Myung and Guld but cut ties after an incident.\nDalmatian High School's wild child. (CV: Takumi Yamazaki)
rows.notes: review: refit: 'childhood friend of' -> 'grew up with'; 'a certain incident' -> 'an incident'

rows.en: Chief developer of the YF-21, a BDI-system prototype, and its\npilot too. He clashes hard with Isamu over the next-gen fighter\nrace and childhood friend Myung. (CV: Unsho Ishizuka)
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: Sharon's producer. Once childhood friends with Isamu and\nGuld, she cut ties after an incident. Meeting them on Eden 7\nyears later, she is torn between the two. (CV: Rika Fukami)
rows.notes: review: refit: 'a certain incident' -> 'an incident'

rows.en: A virtual idol who became the galaxy's No. 1 right after debut.\nWith songs that have a hypnotic effect, she controls people\nand plunges Macross City into chaos.
rows.notes: No CV credit in the source. | review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: My profile? Don't dig into someone's past. Forget that, listen\nto my song! Wanna know me? Hear my song and you'll get it.\nHere we gooo! (CV: Nobutoshi Canna)
rows.notes: Written in Basara's own voice. CV reading: official romanisation 'Nobutoshi Canna' (also credited 'Nobutoshi Kanna'). | review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: FIRE BOMBER's new vocalist. Max and Milia's child, she has\nflown Valkyries since she was little, so she's a fine pilot too.\nAt an age where two boys are on her mind. (CV: Tomo Sakurai)
rows.notes: Band name kept in Latin caps as the source writes it. | review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: An elite pilot who joined special assault unit Diamond Force\nyoung. He saw Basara, who sings in battle, as an enemy, but in\ntime trusts him and the power of song. (CV: Takehito Koyasu)
rows.notes: review: refit: 'believe in' -> 'trusts'

rows.en: For his service in the Zentradi war, he became commander of\nthe Macross 7 colony fleet. Though retired, his genius piloting\nis intact, and he flew Valkyries in ops. (CV: Sho Hayami)
rows.notes: review: refit: 'retired from the front line' -> 'though retired'; 'operations' -> 'ops'

rows.en: City 7's mayor and a former Zentradi ace pilot. She still sorties\nwhen City 7 is attacked, and citizens back her as their fighting\nmayor. (CV: Eri Takeda)
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: Leader of FIRE BOMBER. A former U.N. Forces ace, he left the\nmilitary after an incident. Always backing Basara and Mylene,\nhe claims he's 28, which is doubtful. (CV: Masashi Sugawara)
rows.notes: review: refit: 'a certain incident' -> 'an incident'

rows.en: FIRE BOMBER's drummer. Taciturn, she rarely speaks, and\nmostly communicates through her drums. A pure-blooded\nZentradi with extraordinary strength.
rows.notes: No CV credit in the source. | review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: As Varauta Army commander, he was to raid Macross 7 for\nSpiritia, but he defies Gepelnitchi's orders to awaken one of\nhis comrades, "Sivil". (CV: Tomohiro Nishimura)
rows.notes: review: refit: 'Macross 7 fleet' -> 'Macross 7'

rows.en: He took over the Varauta Army from Gigile and tormented the\nMacross 7 fleet. He dubs all he sees some kind of "Beauty". He\ncan fuse with Glavil into his ultimate form. (CV: Akio Suyama)
rows.notes: Gavil's catchphrase pattern rendered with 'Beauty' per terms.json. | review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: Varauta Army Supreme Commander, with the dread power to\ndrain all the galaxy's Spiritia. For his Spiritia Farm Project,\nmeant to give endless Spiritia, he relentlessly hunted Basara.
rows.notes: No CV credit in the source. | review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: A Protodeviln girl. Drawn to Basara's song, she seeks him\nout again and again. In the end she sings with him and evolves\ninto a self-regenerating Spiritia race. (CV: Akiko Nakagawa)
rows.notes: review: refit: 'in the form of a young girl' -> 'Protodeviln girl'; 'final battle' -> 'in the end'; 'species' -> 'race'

rows.en: "The galaxy sure has some strange folks in it..." -- Graham\n(CV: Nobutoshi Canna)
rows.notes: CV reading: 'Nobutoshi Canna' (also credited 'Nobutoshi Kanna').

rows.en: A taciturn man bent only on killing the white Galaxy Whale that\ntook his right arm and his wife. Oddly, he hit it off with Basara,\nwhich surprised even his daughter Elma. (CV: Joji Nakata)
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line
Developer placeholder text in the source.

rows.en: A sunny, innocent, slightly ditzy girl from planet Zola who\ndreams of being a pro singer. How she makes it and her name\nrings across the galaxy is a tale for later. (CV: Aya Sakaguchi)
rows.notes: CV given name written in hiragana; read as 'Aya'. | review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: A high schooler in pilot training who becomes a Valkyrie pilot\nafter a Vajra attack. Born to a famed kabuki line, his gift and\nlooks once had him play female roles. (CV: Yuichi Nakamura)
rows.notes: review: refit: restructured: 'his gift and looks once had him play female roles'

rows.en: Alto's classmate, a crack sniper. Motto: "Enemies or women, I\nbring down whatever I aim at." He and Klan go way back. His\nolder sister was also a soldier and sniper. (CV: Hiroshi Kamiya)
rows.notes: Motto keeps the double meaning of 'bring down' (shoot down / win over). | review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: Alto's junior. An electronics whiz, he is also special adviser\nto major firm L.A.I.'s tech research division. In battle he flies\nthe EW RVF-25, controlling drone fighters. (CV: Jun Fukuyama)
rows.notes: review: refit: 'electronic-warfare' -> 'EW'; 'unmanned' -> 'drone'

rows.en: Skull Squadron leader in S.M.S., Alto & co.'s private special-ops\nmilitary outfit. Ex-New U.N. Forces veteran, he took in Ranka\nfor certain reasons and cares for her. (CV: Katsuyuki Konishi)
rows.notes: review: refit: 'former' -> 'Ex-'; 'Alto and the others' -> 'Alto & co.'

rows.en: S.M.S. Pixie Team leader, flying a crimson Queadluun-Rhea.\nIn battle she's a giant Zentradi, but when micronized her body\nturns into a little girl's. (CV: Megumi Toyoguchi)
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: S.M.S. Pixie Team leader. Micronized, a genetic anomaly\ngives her a young girl's body, and oddly a childish personality.\nMichel teases her; they always bicker. (CV: Megumi Toyoguchi)
rows.notes: review: refit: compressed; 'always quarrelling' -> 'always bicker'

rows.en: Captain of the Macross Quarter and the pillar of S.M.S.\nA former pilot, reportedly as skilled as Ozma, with a broad\nview that reads the tide of battle. (CV: Toru Okawa)
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: The Super Dimension Cinderella who met Alto & co. and ran up\nthe glorious stairway to idol stardom. Kira☆. Her love battle\nwith Sheryl over Alto has just begun. (CV: Megumi Nakajima)
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

rows.en: A top idol hailed as the Galactic Fairy. Supremely confident in\nbeing Sheryl, she is extremely proud. Her love battle with\nRanka over Alto has only just begun. (CV: Aya Endo)

rows.en: Sheryl's formidable manager, but in truth the mastermind who\nbrought the Vajra to the Frontier fleet. She schemes to use the\npower of Ranka and the Vajra to rule all. (CV: Kikuko Inoue)
rows.notes: review: refit: 'the entire universe' -> 'all'

rows.en: A rookie who has dreamed of being a pilot since he was small.\nHonest and earnest, with a slightly timid streak, but once his\nblood is up, he shows a bold side. (CV: Jun Konno)

rows.en: Raised rich, he wanted for nothing, but bored of a life with no\nthrills, he became a pilot. A seasoned veteran, foul-mouthed\nbut admired as a good big brother. (CV: Tetsu Inada)
rows.notes: Gary Murdoch (male). | review: refit: 'veteran of many battlefields' -> 'seasoned veteran'

rows.en: A passionate pilot who deeply loves the sky. His impulsiveness\nlands him in all kinds of trouble, on and off the job. His hobby\nis collecting oddly patterned T-shirts. (CV: Yuki Hayashi)

rows.en: Born into a military family where all must serve, she became\na pilot, rare for a woman even there. Bright and friendly to all,\nshe often gives men the wrong idea. (CV: Hinako Sasaki)
rows.notes: Miyuki Shirakawa (female). | review: refit: 'with men and women alike' -> 'to all'

rows.en: Trained hard from childhood by her mercenary father, she's\na proven pilot. Perhaps as a single dad raised her, she's rough,\nbut has a feminine side: her hobby is cooking. (CV: Miho Hino)
